name: fill_table_entry_from_registers
description: Computes a record offset from the byte index in D2 and fills that record with the D0 and D1 byte values, fixed flag bytes of 128, a count of 20, the index byte, and a word copied from a second table. It then calls a follow-up routine and returns the incoming D0:D1 pair.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:14194
name: set_state_and_status_codes
description: Stores 18 at offset 23 and 4 at offset 22 of the structure at a0 to record a state and status code. No other fields are touched.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:141A2
name: scan_entry_chain_with_key
description: Builds a lookup key from the D2 and D3 bytes, reads the head of the matching chain, and walks it. Entries of one marker type owned by a different owner are converted to another marker type when a cost value stays under the limit stored in the structure; the walk returns failure on a terminator marker or when the cost reaches the limit.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:141BC
name: scan_entry_chain_from_index
description: Derives a chain index from the low byte of D0, reads the chain head, and walks it. Entries owned by a different owner are converted to another marker type when their cost is under the structure's limit, and the walk fails on a terminator or when the cost reaches the limit.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:141E8
name: scan_entry_chain_from_head
description: Walks a chain starting from the head word passed in D0, skipping the walk entirely when a flag mask from D3 is set. Matching entries owned by another owner are converted to a new marker when their cost is under the structure's limit, and the walk fails on a terminator marker.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:14204
name: walk_chain_claiming_entries
description: Walks the chain starting from the head word in D0 until a zero link is reached, returning zero on completion. key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:14296
name: walk_linked_entries_with_limit
description: Repeatedly checks the structure's owner cost against its limit, then follows the link chain from the current entry. Entries of one marker type owned by another owner are converted to a new marker while the cost stays under the limit, and the routine returns failure on a terminator marker.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:142CC
name: return_fixed_failure_code
description: Returns the constant minus two with no other work. It is a stub whose only effect is the failure return value.

name: dispatch_handler_from_table
description: Reads a word from a table at the slot indexed by the D2 byte and returns zero when it is empty. Otherwise it obtains a structure from a routine, sets its active flag and state fields, and invokes a handler looked up from a second table by that word, returning the handler's result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:142F4
name: initialize_and_dispatch_handler
description: Reads the table entry for the slot in D2 and, when it is set, obtains a structure from a routine, sets its active flag and state fields, and calls a handler looked up from a second table by the table word.

name: initialize_and_dispatch_handler
description: Reads the table entry for the slot in D2 and, when it is set, obtains a structure from a routine, sets its active flag and state fields, and calls a handler looked up from a second table by the table word.

name: link_nearest_eligible_record
description: Scans the global record table for the entry whose two byte fields are closest, by summed absolute differences, to the structure's own bytes, skipping ineligible entries. It links the nearest match to the structure in both directions, sets state code 38, and returns one when a partner is found, otherwise zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1449A
name: link_struct_pair_bidirectionally
description: Stores the address of each of two structures in the other's link field at fixed offsets, then sets the first structure's state code to 38. It returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:144BC
name: return_zero_status
description: Returns zero with no other effect. It is a trivial status-returning stub.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:144C0
name: resolve_linked_partner_state
description: Walks the structure's link chain for a partner entry with a nonzero owner byte that differs from the structure's owner byte, calls routines, and records the outcome in the state fields. When no partner is left it sets a timer of 3276 and state codes 36 and 10.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:144E4
name: initialize_struct_timeout_and_state
description: Writes 20 into the word at offset 20, 36 into the byte at offset 23, 10 into the byte at offset 22, and 3276 into the word at offset 10 of the structure at a0. It only sets these constants.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:144FE
name: match_partner_by_owner_byte
description: Walks the link chain for an entry whose count is positive and whose owner byte is nonzero and differs from the caller's owner byte, then records the result in the structure's state fields. When no candidate remains it sets a timer of 3276 and the same state codes used by its failure path.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:14520
name: store_state_and_status_bytes
description: Stores 38 at offset 23 and 4 at offset 22 of the structure at a0 to record a state and status code. No other fields are touched.

name: compute_scaled_step_toward_target
description: Derives signed step directions by comparing two input bytes with the structure's position bytes, then checks neighbouring cells from a lookup table and calls routines for each cell that differs. It writes both steps scaled by a per-structure byte into two word fields and sets two byte fields to 128.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:14552
name: apply_scaled_step_from_registers
description: Uses the signed step values passed in D2 and D3 to check neighbouring cells from a lookup table, calling routines for each cell that differs. It writes both steps scaled by a per-structure byte into two word fields and sets two byte fields to 128.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:14592
name: record_cell_and_scaled_step
description: Writes the structure's address and its two position bytes, offset by the step values in D2 and D3, into the table entry for its index. It then walks eight neighbour offsets calling a routine for each mismatch, and finally writes the scaled step and sets two byte fields to 128.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:14654
name: clear_entity_links_and_flags
description: If the structure's flag bit is set, it clears its link slot and any back-reference to it, and when its state is 10 it walks a chain of linked entries clearing their links and flag bit and setting a status byte to 2. It also clears a second back-reference and returns its incoming D0 value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:146D8
name: spawn_copies_into_free_slots
description: When a flag is clear and a count is positive, it shifts a flag word right by one and, for each requested copy, copies the source record into the next free record in the global table. Each copy has two link words cleared, a state byte of 36 set, and a routine called on it.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1472E
name: copy_record_to_free_slot
description: Copies the source record word by word into the destination record, clears two link words, sets a state byte of 36 and a field of zero, and calls a routine. It repeats for the remaining count, moving to the next free record each time.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:14768
name: adjust_indexed_word_by_divisor
description: Reads a word from a table at the index in D0 and, unless it is the all-ones sentinel or the divisor byte looked up for it is zero, subtracts the word divided by that divisor. It returns the adjusted word together with the D1 input.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:147E0
name: call_routine_if_table_nonnegative
description: When a flag global is clear and the signed word from a table at the index in D2 is not negative, it calls a routine. Otherwise it returns the incoming D0 and D1 values unchanged.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:14826
name: return_stack_argument_pair
description: Returns the two 16-bit stack arguments unchanged as a pair, with no other work.

name: handle_undecompiled_routine
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this eight-instruction routine, so its behaviour cannot be read from the code. It is called from two places and calls two other routines.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15A8C
name: clear_owner_unless_protected_range
description: Returns the incoming registers unchanged when the structure address lies in one fixed address range, and calls a routine when it lies in a second range. Otherwise it clears the owner byte at offset 12 and returns the routine's result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15A9E
name: clear_owner_or_call_routine
description: Calls a routine and returns the incoming registers when the structure address lies inside a fixed range. Otherwise it clears the owner byte at offset 12 and returns the routine's result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15AC2
name: clear_owner_and_call_routine
description: Sets the owner byte at offset 12 of the structure to zero and calls a routine routine.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15ACE
name: handle_undecompiled_stub
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this two-instruction routine, so its behaviour cannot be read from the code. It is called from one place and calls one other routine.

name: handle_undecompiled_large_routine
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this 43-instruction routine, so its behaviour cannot be read from the code. It is called from three places and calls three other routines.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15B7A
name: fill_first_free_entry_slot
description: Sets bits of a constant mask in the word at a0, then computes a value from a routine result and a lookup table. When the value passes a mask test it fills the first free 32-byte entry with owner, position and state fields, calls routines, and returns one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15BC2
name: initialize_record_from_arguments
description: Writes the owner from D2 and the value from D1 into the structure at A3, sets fixed flag bytes and word fields, and adds a lookup-table value to a global. It calls routines and returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15C36
name: return_zero_status
description: Returns zero with no other effect. It is a trivial status-returning stub.

name: initialize_empty_entry_slot
description: Scans a fixed table of 32-byte entries for a free slot and returns zero when none is free. In a free slot it stores the owner from D2, two position bytes, a type code of 32, a timer of 1224 and a lookup-table value, then calls a routine and returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15CC8
name: allocate_entry_and_mark_matches
description: Searches a table of offset words for a free slot, then stores the owner byte, two position bytes, type code 36, state 14, a lookup-table value and a timer of 151 in that 32-byte entry. It then walks a sentinel-terminated list of words and writes a sequence number into each cell whose flag test passes.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15D0A
name: allocate_first_free_entry_slot
description: Scans the global entry table for the first free 32-byte slot and fills it with the owner byte, two position bytes, type code 36, state 14, a lookup-table value and a timer of 151. It then walks a sentinel-terminated list of words and writes a sequence number into each cell whose flag test passes.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15D28
name: initialize_entry_and_mark_matches
description: Fills the 32-byte entry at A3 with the owner byte, two position bytes, type code 36, state 14, a lookup-table value and a timer of 151. It then walks a sentinel-terminated list of words and writes a sequence number into each cell whose flag test passes.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15DD6
name: return_stack_argument_unchanged
description: Returns the stack argument unchanged with no other work.

name: return_stack_argument_unchanged
description: Returns the stack argument unchanged with no other work.

name: claim_entry_for_slot_head
description: If the slot head for the D2 index is empty, it claims the first free entry in the global table, makes it the head, and fills it with position bytes, type code 40, state 22 and a timer of 1760. key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15E1E
name: claim_entry_into_pointer_field
description: Finds the first free entry in the global table, stores its address in the word at offset 18 of the structure at A1, and fills the entry with the owner and position bytes, type code 40, state 22 and a timer of 1760. It then calls a routine and returns its result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15E3C
name: store_link_and_fill_entry
description: Stores the address of the target entry in the word at offset 18 of the structure at A1, then fills that entry with the owner and position bytes, type code 40, state 22 and a timer of 1760. It finishes by calling a routine.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15E8A
name: spawn_entries_around_slot_head
description: For a slot head that has no child entries, it repeatedly takes a free entry, places it at a position offset from the head by a lookup table with clamped bytes, and links it into the head's list. Each new entry gets type code 42 and state 24, and the loop continues while a routine returns nonzero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15EE2
name: spawn_linked_offset_entries
description: Repeatedly gets a value from a routine, indexes a lookup table with it, and derives two clamped position bytes from the source structure. Each new entry is linked to the source in both directions with type code 42 and state 24, and the loop continues while the routine returns nonzero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15F80
name: clear_slot_head_and_chain
description: If the slot head for the D2 index is set, it clears that slot, sets the head's status byte to 26 and a word to 1824, then walks its linked list clearing each node's owner byte and calling a routine for each node.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:15FDA
name: update_slot_bounding_region
description: When a cell's flag test passes, it marks that cell and either creates a bounding entry for the slot or widens the slot's existing bounds to include the given position. It then copies the updated bounds into the mirror fields of the slot record.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1604E
name: expand_bounds_to_include_point
description: Widens the extent bytes of the structure at A3 so they include the position in D0 and D1, then copies the position and extent bytes into their mirror fields.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16076
name: expand_vertical_bounds_to_include
description: Widens the vertical extent byte of the structure at A3 so it includes the position in D1, then copies the position and extent bytes into their mirror fields.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:160A4
name: create_bounded_entry_for_struct
description: Finds a free entry in the global table and stores the owner byte, positions one less than the inputs, extents of two, and type code 38 with state 18. It sets a value from a lookup table adjusted by a byte of the source structure, then links the new entry's address into the structure's word at offset 14.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:160C2
name: initialize_bounded_entry_at_pointer
description: Fills the entry at A3 with the owner byte, positions one less than the inputs, extents of two, and type code 38 with state 18. It sets a value from a lookup table adjusted by a byte of the structure at A1, then links the entry's address into that structure's word at offset 14.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16132
name: set_timer_and_link_state

description: Runs one pass over four channel slots, moving each state zero, one or two slot forward. It stores each slot's values into a 16-byte channel table, calls routines, and sets a shared byte when the slot is finished.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1978C

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:197A4
name: apply_channel_pitch_table_value

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:197BE

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1980E

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19866

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1989C

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:198E6

name: walk_channel_commands_until_end
description: Walks a channel's command bytes until the minus-one terminator, applying each command and computing the scaled output level at the end.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19936
name: copy_matching_names_uppercase
description: Calls library routines to scan entries and compares each name against a fixed suffix string held in a global buffer. Matching names are copied into a buffer with lower-case letters converted to upper case, and the match count is stored in a global word.

description: Copies a name into the buffer in upper case and then calls library routines to continue scanning entries until none remain. The match count is stored when the scan ends.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:199D8
name: call_indirect_and_store
description: Calls a routine through a pointer computed from the A5 register, then stores a saved global value and the D7 input word into two globals. It then calls a routine.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:199F8

name: check_library_lookup_result
description: Queries an item count through the library base and, when positive, invokes an operation. It returns one when the second result equals the fixed code 56690 and zero otherwise, restoring a saved global before returning.

name: verify_library_result_code
description: Queries an item count through the library base and, when it is positive, invokes an operation. It returns one when the result equals the fixed code 56690 and zero otherwise.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19BB8
name: compare_library_result_to_code
description: Calls library routines through the library base, then returns one when the first call's result equals the fixed code 56690 and zero otherwise. It restores a saved global before returning.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19C08

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19C1C
name: query_library_result_word
description: Queries an item count through the library base and, when it is positive, invokes an operation and returns its result word if the code equals 56690. Otherwise it returns zero and restores a saved global.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19C62
